data.action: 漫步在枫林落叶小径上，单手伸手接住飘落的红枫，回眸温柔微笑
data.description: 卡西米尔郊外金秋时节的枫树林中，金红色的落叶铺满了林间石子小径。薇薇安娜裹着温暖的驼色羊毛风衣与米色高领毛衣，金色的鹿角间俏皮地戴着一顶贝雷帽。她伸出戴着皮手套的手掌，轻轻接住一片飘落的红枫，侧脸美得宛如油画——「秋天总是让人不由自主地想写诗呢。博士，能陪我走完这段小径吗？」
data.lighting: 穿透金黄枫叶树冠的柔和斑驳暖阳与落叶反射光
data.location: 郊外金红枫树林落叶小径
data.promptProse: Strolling along a stone woodland path carpeted with crimson and amber leaves in her cropped camel wool coat, cream turtleneck, and houndstooth skirt, Viviana extends one open hand to catch a drifting red maple leaf. She pauses mid-step beneath the golden autumn canopy and turns partway toward the viewer with a poised, poetic smile. Warm dappled afternoon sunlight filters through the maple boughs, gilding the falling leaves and the soft wool of her coat.
data.title: 薇薇安娜 · 金秋枫林中的漫步沉思
data.animaCaption: Walking down the leaf-strewn maple forest path in her camel wool coat, Viviana extends one hand to catch a falling red leaf and turns back with a gentle smile. Warm dappled afternoon sunlight filters through the golden canopy across her shoulders.
